description: Places a 15-minute HOLD on the room and emails the guest a 6-digit code. Nothing is booked and nothing reaches the hotel until the guest confirms. After calling, tell the guest: check your email (the result shows the masked address), then either read the code back to you (call confirm_booking) or click Confirm in the email. Send an idempotency_key and reuse it if you retry. Confirm name, email, dates and price with the guest before calling. Demo hotels (demo: true) confirm at once and send no email.

agent.description: Name of the AI agent/app placing the request

idempotency_key.description: One per booking attempt (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -). Reuse it on retries to get the same hold back.

notes.description: Requests for the hotel, e.g. late arrival

name: book_direct
title: Book direct with the hotel
